message:
How it reads now:
Entries sheet
Description (text, required), Type (Income or Expense, required), Category (Sales, Services, Other income, Salaries, Software, Travel, Office, Marketing, Taxes or Other), Amount (money, required), Date (date, required, today), Paid to or received from (text), Recorded by (person, whoever adds it), Receipt (file), Notes (long text).

Who can see and do what
Wade Wilson sees every entry, add and edit them, and change how it works.
Recorders see their own entries and can add and edit them.
Everyone else sees nothing.

Connections
People fills Recorded by.

Coming soon
Connections to other software

Latest message:
what other sheets can be added here to improve this capability?
